capabilities: conceal double colons in Reading view
optionally conceal double colons in Live Preview editing
keep double colons visible on the active line, in selections, and in Source mode
expose a CSS class for custom styling of concealed colons
extras: README warns to restart Obsidian after installing to avoid render caching issues; editing-view concealment is off by default.
intentEvidence: display double colon (i.e. Dataview inline fields) as a single colon for more natural reading experience
problem: Dataview inline fields use a double colon, which reads unnaturally when notes are rendered or edited.

relations.evidence: Display double colon (i.e. Dataview inline fields) as a single colon

summary: Display plugin that conceals Dataview inline field double colons (::) as a single colon in Reading view and optionally in Live Preview.
